cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Change that one line call to 'out'. Leave the match score as it is; I'm asking for a correction, not a rematch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Changing the call makes my winning point look wrong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then separate the call from the recorded result. Put a note under the score, not through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll add the note if you sign that the result stands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Write 'call corrected, result unchanged'. Give me the pen after you've written both parts; I won't sign a blank assurance.
